d:
Experience the festive magic of Nagada Sang Dhol from Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela in stunning 8K/4K! Featuring the powerful vocals of Shreya Ghoshal & Osman Mir, this energetic Bollywood hit brings together vibrant Garba beats, traditional folk rhythms and unforgettable dance moves.
Credits:
Song – Nagada Sang Dhol
Movie – Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela
Singers – Shreya Ghoshal & Osman Mir
Music Composer – Sanjay Leela Bhansali
Lyricists – Siddharth-Garima
Featuring – Deepika Padukone & Ranveer Singh
